title: Aleem — rough outside, polished within
rights: Original procedural geometry, materials, lighting and composition authored for this portfolio. No imported images or models. Existing novel covers remain separate owner-provided assets.
generationNote: Hosted Blender construction, rendering and GLB export only. No paid generate_image, generate_video or image-to-3D request was submitted.

design.subject: Asymmetric fractured carbon cradle exposing a precisely machined polished heart
design.personalElement: Subtle copper A construction mark and silicon-like trace paths
design.intent: Translate Aleem's rough-edged curiosity and precise engineering into one object rather than a generic luxury jewel.
design.motion: Frontend-native scroll and pointer choreography use separately pivoted carbon shards; no autonomous infinite spin is embedded in the asset.

coordinates.notes: Use RIG_Specimen for the website. Delivery camera, studio floor, plinth and light rig are separate scene nodes.

structural: 23 meshes, 6 materials, no external or missing texture images
15 individually centroid-pivoted shell nodes with preserved rest translations
Core dimensions and exported Y-up/front+Z conversion checked
visual: Verified exposed polished core, carbon/metal contrast, legible copper A, unclipped silhouette and left-side negative space
verification.optimization: Original 1,305,262-byte PNG encoded to an 18,910-byte WebP at quality 86; no semantic alteration.
verification.limitations: Procedural environment lighting is not embedded in GLB. The website supplies its own reflection environment. Renderer-specific appearance is verified again in browser screenshots.
